text:
ivy: quick UX nits from today's review — dataset row shows 'eu' / '90' / 'KMS' and it's confusing.

jon: can you paste mock?

ivy: https://figma.redwood/dataset-row-compact — top-right meta: region, retention, encryption.

mira: security note: never show raw key material. show alias or 'Redwood-managed' / 'Customer KMS'.

rachel: a11y nit: badges must be keyboard-focusable and not rely on color alone. Add aria-label like 'Encrypted. Managed by Redwood'.

jon: copy proposals: 'Region: eu-west-1 (EU)', 'Retention: 90 days', badge short: 'Encrypted  Redwood-managed' (visual) and SR text 'Encrypted. Managed by Redwood'.

ivy: mobile: no hover so tap opens bottom sheet with header 'Encryption  dataset name' + 'Managed by: Redwood' and 'View audit' CTA.

mira: audit lines should read human-friendly: 'Encryption applied  key alias: redwood-prod-01 (KMS); actor: infra-service; time: Dec 2, 2025 16:10 UTC'. No secret material.

rachel: contrast: badge green needs darker text or outline variant for compact view. Also modal close button should be explicit: 'Close encryption details'.

jon: I'll update CSS to outline variant in compact rows, add aria-haspopup=dialog on badge, and SR copy.

deploy-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood/preview/dataset-meta-ux-2025 build#4310 (branch: ds-meta-ux-nits)

ivy: thanks — checklist: jon push PR, rachel validate a11y on preview, mira sign off on audit fields. Closing when all green.
